answers.core: Implementing this proposal restores the regressed `Input.get_accelerometer()` feature on the Windows Platform.  This is already a core feature in Godot which has become unavailable on the Windows Platform due to the circumstances described above.
answers.workaround: This issue cannot be worked around.  The Windows Desktop Export needs to be modified to ensure the Windows Platform supports devices with touch input and an accelerometer sensor.

title: Add support for the accelerometer sensor to `Input.get_accelerometer()` for Windows Desktop export
